_comment: Control-plane IdP realm — PLATFORM_ARCHITECTURE.md § 5.2. Separate realm, not a separate role: no customer identity can obtain a control-plane token because the realm is different, rather than because a claim is checked.
_requirements: mandatory hardware or TOTP MFA — no password-only path exists
short-lived session: 30 min idle, 8 h absolute
step-up re-auth for destructive operations (tenant deletion, plan override, impersonation)
